reviews.title: New timer is awful
reviews.text: I loved this timer, my absolute favorite. You changed it yesterday and I hate the new sound and really hate that you turn the volume of my music down. I will find a new timer

reviews.title: De pago
reviews.text: Ha pasado a ser de pago, lo desinstalo

reviews.title: Charging money
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for years and I loved it… now they want to charge you to have a timer! That is all absolutely ridiculous. You just lost a long time user and willl not longer tell people about this app

reviews.title: Problemas con el pago
reviews.text: Hace años pagué la suscripción de por vida y la verdad que la aplicación genial, la usaba para dar clases en un gimnasio y no tenía queja. Mi sorpresa fué cuando quise usarle recientemente y debo volver a pagar el pase o la suscripción mensual. Traté de contactar com asistencia pero no recibo respuesta.

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text: I’ve been using the app for years now.  Today I got hit with a pay wall add can’t use it anymore without paying.  Sorry it’s not worth $20 or a monthly subscription.  That said it’s simple and works well.

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text: Tras el primer uso ya obliga a pagar para seguir utilizándolo
